# clavis admin verify-backup

<p class="cli-lead">Check that a backup can be decrypted and read, without touching the live database</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin verify-backup FILE [flags]
```

</div>

Check that a backup file can be decrypted with this server's root key
and read. For SQLite it opens a temporary copy, runs SQLite's integrity
check and counts organizations, projects, environments and secrets, so
an empty, truncated or damaged backup is caught. For Postgres it checks
that the dump is complete. The live database and the backup file are not
changed.

Run it after each backup, or on a schedule, so you find out that a
backup is unusable before you need it.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin verify-backup clavis-backup.enc
```

<p class="cli-example-title">In a script</p>

```sh
clavis admin verify-backup clavis-backup.enc --json
```
